abi_facts: 64-bit NSUInteger fields for MTLSize and NSRange.
Exact method signatures, including structures by value, are selected before dispatch.
Native command states 0/1 unknown, 2/3 pending, 4 completed, 5 error.
Create/new native objects own +1; autoreleased command buffers retained before pool drain.
MTLOrigin uses three NSUInteger coordinates. MTLTextureSwizzleChannels is four uint8 channels, size4 alignment1.
Texture type numbers 0/1/2/3/5/6/7; native shader read/write/render/view usage bits 1/2/4/16.
Sampler min/mag filter0/1, mipfilter1/2, address0/2/3, compare0..7; LOD setters take float.
Per-slice array buffer transfers use native bytesPerImage0 and origin.z0; volume transfers use slice0 and nonzero origin.z/depth as requested.
GPUFamily uses NSInteger; Mac2=2002, Apple2=1002, Apple3=1003. Exposed dimension limits are conservative published family bounds, not a hardware qualification.
Render write-mask bits R=8,G=4,B=2,A=1; blend operations0..4 and admitted factors0..14.
Load actions discard/load/clear=0/1/2; admitted store discard/store=0/1. Multisample/resolve not admitted.
ClearColor is four doubles; viewport is six doubles; scissor is four NSUInteger fields passed by value.
Stencil clear/reference/readMask/writeMask setters take uint32; depth clear takes double; depth-write uses native BOOL.
Indexed draw baseVertex is signed NSInteger; other primitive/count/offset/base-instance fields are NSUInteger.
deliberate_retained_differences: Images use private storage and staging transfers rather than the retained bridge shared-storage assumption; no CPU texture mapping is offered.
Explicit view counts/native enums replace retained WebGPU fallback/default conversions; public translation remains upstream.
2D native bytesPerImage is zero per the current Apple method contract, while the buffer image stride still advances each array layer.
One resource/command owner publishes per-subresource initialization only on native success; no second public lifetime policy.
Explicit vertex/fragment source spans and resolved symbols replace retained fallback shader/name behavior; no shader synthesis.
A zero native color write mask stays zero, rather than retained fallback-to-all behavior.
Per-stage sparse binding snapshots clear absent slots between draws; no blanket aliasing of vertex and fragment bindings.
Whole-pass preflight and one completion owner retain every attachment/view and pipeline before native encoding; combined depth/stencil stays rejected until aspect-qualified initialization exists.
